The Amulet of the Void can be recharged in a Box of the Void with a Mana Battery - Class Five both of which can be bought from the Key Master on the first Island for about 55 platinum. This item is not usable within the Plane of Sky, prior to the Chardok revamp era. From that era on, it can be used even in Sky. name: Forged Javelin
notes: '''Stackable.''' 18pp per stack. As of 9/6/2016, they are the longest range throwing weapon for monks that is stackable and easily crafted in large quantities, except for Antonian Javelins which only humans may craft but both races may use. Depending on Blacksmithing skill and luck, the cost of crafting these is about 11pp per stack. If a monk blacksmith is trying to cut down on weight and cost, the humble Forged Throwing Axe is a good compromise.

name: Forged Throwing Axe
notes: '''Stackable.''' 7pp per stack. For half the weight of a Forged Javelin, you still get sufficient range for most indoor pulling. These are an excellent choice for low and mid level monks until they get their Grand Master's Wrist Wraps.

These are the longest range stackable monk throwing weapons, however they are difficult to mass manufacture because temper required is sold in Thurgadin while molds are sold in other cities. They are also expensive, being over 4pp per jav in costs from temper alone. A blacksmith should consider making the Forged Javelin instead, which is far more efficient.

name: Mortificator Staff
effect: Mana Sink (Combat, Casting Time: Instant) at Level 30
notes: Vendors for 15p. Although not very impressive for use in grouping or soloing, especially early on, it can be invaluable in certain instances where there are no Enchanters to sieve a CH or gate raid target. Good damage ratios make this a serviceable shaman weapon at early levels for added dps, but the proc effect is useless against just about any mob as they're likely to be dead five times over by the time you can land enough procs to prevent them from CH-ing or gating. While it can be resisted, after Malo, several shamans using them in succession can successfully prevent mobs from gating or at a minimum reduce the number of CHs west waste dragons will perform.Also worth mention is that besides the Staff of Discord and Withered Totem of Widdershins, this is the only Shaman exclusive weapon that uses this item model; very fashionable.
